The Eldergulch S3 campaign ran from Oct 24 through Oct 31 (midnight Mountain on Nov 1) and spent $697.03 of the $700 budget. Note that this recap covers link clicks, not streams. X can't see streams without your pixel, so I couldn't optimize for them or measure them. Please pull the stream counts from your podcast platforms and compare them with the figures below.

**Final recap**
- **Spend:** $697.03 of $700.00
- **Impressions:** 424,972
- **Link clicks:** 293
- **Cost per link click:** about $2.38 overall

**By ad group**
- **Podcast listeners - US:** $498.91 spent, 246 link clicks (about $2.03 each), 332,096 impressions. This was the stronger group.
- **Horror & Thriller fans - US:** $198.12 spent, 47 link clicks (about $4.22 each), 92,876 impressions.

**What I did**
- Created one campaign with two US-only ad groups, both using the four approved posts and no new copy.
- Used link clicks to the season page as the goal, since that's the closest measurable action available. Clicks don't prove someone started an episode.
- On Oct 26, I moved budget toward the podcast-listeners group, which was clearly cheaper per click. I cut the horror group's total from $350 to $200 and raised the podcast group's from $350 to $500. The total stayed at $700.
- The campaign ended on its own at the scheduled end time, so nothing is still running.

**Things to know**
- The podcast-listeners interest audience performed better than the horror audience. If you run this again, start with more budget on that audience.
- I couldn't get one stats query for the full seven days. The API rejected the window, so I pulled Oct 24–28 and Oct 28–Nov 1 separately and added them together.
